publications.title: ToxiFrench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Language Models via CoT Fine-Tuning for French Toxicity Detection
publications.meta: Axel Delaval, Shujian Yang, Haicheng Wang, Han Qiu, Jialiang Lu — Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU), 2025
publications.desc: ToxiFrench introduces a public benchmark of 53,622 French online comments for toxicity detection, built through a semi-automated annotation pipeline combining language models and human validation. We show that small language models often outperform larger ones in robustness, and propose a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fine-tuning strategy that improves F1 scores by 13% and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

projects.title: ToxiFrench: French Toxicity Detection
projects.desc: Dataset and models for French toxicity detection. The dataset, models, source code, and associated paper are available on the project page.

projects.title: Comment Banners: VS Code Extension for Comment Banners
projects.desc: VS Code extension that lets developers quickly insert styled comment banners to structure and beautify code. It automatically adapts to the comment syntax of each language (C, Python, LaTeX, etc.) and offers multiple banner styles (double line, rounded, classic, arrowed, etc.). The source code is available on GitHub.

projects.title: LaTeX Shortcuts: Keyboard Shortcuts for LaTeX in VS Code
projects.desc: VS Code extension offering fast keyboard shortcuts for LaTeX formatting. It automatically wraps selected text with commands such as \textbf{...}, $...$, \left(...\right), or \underline{...}, making LaTeX writing smoother and more enjoyable. Source code is available on GitHub.

projects.title: RepoToPrompt: Converting Git Repositories into Structured Text for LLMs
projects.desc: RepoToPrompt is a Python tool that converts an entire Git repository into a single structured text document, ideal for auditing, archiving, or large-language-model prompting. It allows fine-grained filtering of included files, skips binaries, removes base64-encoded notebook images, and supports custom headers. Inspired by gpt-repository-loader, it offers more flexible control over extensions and output format.
